en: If you let them convict me for these... infractions, you'll be on your own. No one to hold your hand, no one to pay your bills, you'll have to solve your own problems.
Are you ready for that?
[forceful]Okay, that's enough.
He was attacking me.
Georgie, Tweedle Dum... who else has he torn apart?

So, murder is acceptable when the government is behind it?
Dum was attacking me! You sent him. Or did you forget that part?
That is enough!
You're avoiding the issue! You have a lot to answer for and all you've done is talk about us.
I'm just making sure everyone here knows what your decision would mean for Fabletown.
What my absence would mean for everyone here.
Oh, you're right. You were in danger.
But that's not always the case, is it?

{AngryA}[muttering]Asshole.

[angry; insulted]He was a sick fucking bastard who stole from this town and used that money for his own disgusting ends.

[contained anger]I think you've said enough.

These things take time.
[forceful]That is enough!
[forceful]You've had your chance to talk. You're done.

Are you so sure?
I've been helping these people!

We would all be better off without you.

[indignant]Me?
{NormalA}	[angry]You're not serious!

[uncomfortable]Thank you... Bluebeard.
